draft.title: Cause, effect, continuity and change
card: Cause
something that made an event happen. A cause comes before the event.
Effect
something that followed from an event. An effect comes after it.
Continuity
something that stayed the same over a period of time.
Change
something that became different over a period of time.
draft.remember: Causes come before an event and effects come after it. Continuity stays the same and change is different.

a.q: A flood leaves farmers in an ancient valley with no crops. Some farmers then move to a nearby town. What is the move to the town?
opts: An effect of the flood
A cause of the flood
A continuity across the period
A cause of the farmers' hunger
a.why: The move happened after the flood and followed from it, so it is an effect. It is not a cause of the flood, because a cause must come before the event it explains.
a.clue: Did the move happen before or after the flood?

b.q: Over 500 years, a village keeps farming the same river land. Its homes change from reed huts to mud-brick houses. Which pair is correct?
opts: Farming is continuity and the houses are change
Farming is change and the houses are continuity
Both farming and the houses are continuity
Both farming and the houses are change
b.why: The villagers kept farming the same land, so that stayed the same: continuity. Their homes became different, which is change. Both can be true in the same village over the same period.
b.clue: Ask of each thing: was it the same or different at the end?

b.best: Farming is continuity and the houses are change

problems.detail: The stem says the homes 'change' and that the village 'keeps farming the same' land. These words echo the card's definitions, so a student can match words to terms without understanding continuity and change. Something like 'Its homes go from reed huts to mud-brick houses' would avoid this.

check.summary: The card, the remember line and both questions are accurate, and each question has one clearly right answer. The one problem: question b's stem uses the words 'change' and 'the same', which give the answer away.
